title: Scale Kit: Rapid Adjust, Predictive Preview, and Change Ledger
creator: Priya Natarajan
description: Build a compact Fleet Controls surface in Console called 'Scale Kit' that enables operators to perform rapid scaling adjustments, preview predicted throughput impact, and inspect an auditable ledger of recent changes. The feature should integrate with the autoscaling policy editor and Dedicated capacity SLAs, show model-aware throughput projections, and provide immutable operator annotations and rollback actions. The intent is to reduce incident MTTR for capacity issues, improve confidence during manual overrides, and provide clear change provenance for compliance and post-incident review.
background: Operators currently flip between the capacity manifest editor, the autoscale policy editor, and separate throughput dashboards when responding to high-latency incidents. This creates cognitive friction, increases risk of misconfiguration, and slows corrective action. Recent incidents (INC-2025-011 and INC-2025-014) showed manual scale overshoot and missing annotations in audit logs. Scale Kit should consolidate controls and histories into a single, operator-friendly workflow with guardrails and predictive telemetry.
acceptance_criteria: Compact 'Scale Kit' panel accessible from Fleet > Actions that allows +/− capacity adjustments in discrete steps and percentage changes
Predictive preview visual showing estimated throughput, P95 latency, and cost delta for the selected change, computed from the last 6 hours of real telemetry
Integration link to autoscaling policy editor: any manual change can be converted to a temporary policy override with defined TTL
Change Ledger records operator identity, timestamp, before/after capacity, reason (free-text), and optional runbook link; ledger entries are immutable and searchable
Rollback action available on each ledger entry with confirmation and automated safety checks (capacity floor, SLA checks)
Throughput heatmap and request-level rate overlay in the panel for context without leaving the Scale Kit
RBAC checks enforced: only roles with 'fleet.operator' or above can apply changes; UI disables buttons otherwise
E2E tests for optimistic concurrency when two operators attempt simultaneous adjustments
Telemetry events emitted for each manual change, with tags: operator_id, fleet_id, prior_capacity, new_capacity, override_ttl
Design accessibility review completed and responsive layout verified for narrow consoles
ui_notes: Primary controls: stepper (+1 GPU / -1 GPU), percentage slider, and a 'Burst Mode' quick toggle for short-lived additional capacity. Predictive preview should use a lightweight simulation on recent traces to keep latency of preview under 150ms. Ledger rows should show a diff badge and quick links to related PRs/Runbooks.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Operators may over-rely on predictive preview during extreme distribution changes. Mitigation: show confidence band and require confirmation for large changes; surface last-simulated window time.
Risk: Audit log tampering. Mitigation: write ledger events to append-only store and log to the audit Kinesis stream used by infra; add HMAC in backend.
Risk: Predictive estimator consuming heavy resources. Mitigation: bounded sampling window and precomputed aggregated metrics; fallback to conservative estimate when model is busy.
qa_plan: Smoke: create a small test fleet and apply +1/-1 adjustments; verify telemetry and ledger entries
Edge: simulate concurrent adjustments from two operator sessions; verify optimistic concurrency and conflict UI
Regression: verify autoscale policies are unchanged unless user chooses 'convert to policy'
Security: run RBAC matrix test for multiple roles and verify UI button state
rollout_plan: Feature-flag behind 'scale_kit_v1' for first 10% of orgs
Staged rollout to ops teams with internal docs and one-hour office hours
Monitor key metrics for 72 hours: manual_change_rate, rollback_rate, MTTR_incidents
